say:0:1910629301:1.text: The Graveborn aims to awaken the ancient Mother Goddess, who lies in deep slumber at the far reaches of the Shimmering Sea. She belongs to a bygone era and has long since been forgotten by the current Merfolk.
say:0:1910629301:1.source_cn: 亡灵的目的是唤醒“母神”。那是一位古老的、沉睡在流光海...
